mods.name: VisualsFabric
mods.description: An optimized Fabric 26.3/1.21.4 mod purely for visuals - shaders, rendering enhancements, and visual effects

releases.notes:
## VisualsFabric v1.0.1

### Fixes
- Fixed Mixin crash when attacking entities -  injection now uses  instead of 

### Features
- Bloom post-processing
- Chromatic aberration
- Film grain
- Vignette
- God Rays (volumetric lighting)
- Lens Flare
- Chat message effects (fade, slide, scale, typewriter, glitch animations)
- Player trails and afterimages
- Block highlighting (ores, chests, mobs, custom)
- Photo mode with depth of field
- In-game config GUI with categories
- Key bindings for all features

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.4
- Fabric Loader 0.20.1
- Fabric API 0.119.4+
- Java 21

Built with Fabric Loom 1.9.2
